pages.text: Sleeves had heard about the balloon festival at the top of the Stormy Mountains from a traveller on the road. He knew he just had to see the balloons for himself; he wondered how it must be to fly in one!

Part way up the mountain, it began to storm with the fury of an angry deity! But for some reason, Sleeves was not scared in all of the crickle and crackle. In-fact, he felt strangely comfortable in the chaos!

Halfway up the mountain, he met a little boy name Pochi. Pochi told him that he his uncle owns a balloon and he was going to go and ride it with his cousin at the festival! He said Sleeves could come as well if he wanted!

Finally Sleeves and Pohci arrived at the great city of Kikyuu! Sleeves had never seen such a city! Built atop a great waterfall, with magical bridges running to towers of stone, it was so huge! Sleeves could see some of the balloons starting to take off. Sleeves and Pochi raced to the uncles house!

Sleeves, Pochi, and Trebel took off on family balloon! Far and away they soared, across fields of corn and bluebells, across rippling lakes of strange fish Sleeves had never seen, amongst birds of every colour Sleeves had ever seen.

Eventually, Pochi and Trebel let Sleeves down at the magnolia tree at the bottom of the other side of the mountain. 'Thank you for being our friend Sleeves! We hope you come and visit again one day!' Sleeves wondered if he had an Uncle with a hot air balloon, somewhere in the world.
